name: Deceivers
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against deceivers who appear harmless but harbor destructive intentions, likened to wolves in sheep's clothing. These false teachers are rooted in the devil, the ultimate father of lies and deception, who rejects truth and promotes unrighteousness. Those who embrace such deceit and live in falsehood are warned of severe judgment, as all liars will share in the second death, highlighting the grave spiritual danger posed by deception.
